Container.Name: UnDash
Container.Overview: UnDash: a compact server dashboard for Unraid (system overview, media, Arr Stack, download clients, containers, VMs). It reads and manages the server through the official Unraid API with an API key: no Docker socket, no privileged mode. Create the key in Settings > Management Access > API Keys (read: Info, Array, Disk, Docker, VMs; update: Docker, VMs). On first start the container log shows a one-time setup code for choosing the dashboard password.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port of the dashboard. If the UnDash plugin's own port (also 9099) is turned on, pick another one here or turn the plugin's port off.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Settings, secrets (API keys) and backups. Kept across updates. Separate from the plugin's folder so both can run side by side.

Config.Name: Unraid API address
Config.Description: Your server's address followed by /graphql (use https:// if Unraid forces it). Can also be set in Settings > Configuration.

Config.Name: Unraid API key
Config.Description: The API key you created in Unraid. Kept on the server; never sent to the browser.

Config.Name: Dashboard password
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty to choose the password in the browser with the setup code from the container log.

Config.Name: Import plugin settings
Config.Description: Optional, read-only: map /mnt/user/appdata/undash (the plugin's settings) to copy your layout, apps and secrets on the very first start. Nothing is overwritten; remove the mapping afterwards.
